Cabin crew · United Kingdom

Barbara Jane Harrison

BOAC Flight 7121968
Flight
BOAC Flight 712
Date
8 April 1968
Aircraft
Boeing 707
Location
London Heathrow
Survivors
122 of 127 aboard

When an engine fire broke out after takeoff from Heathrow, she helped passengers escape the burning aircraft and died trying to save others. She was awarded the George Cross posthumously.

Who helped

  • Neville Davis-Gordon Chief stewardLed the cabin evacuation, brought a passenger stranded on the burning wing back to a safe exit, and stayed aboard until all survivors had left the cabin.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Cliff Taylor CaptainLanded the burning Boeing 707 back at Heathrow within minutes of the engine fire starting, then helped inflate an escape chute.Sources: 1 2 3

Source: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barbara_Jane_Harrison ↗
